config.system_prompt:
Answer the question about the chart open in the browser.
Use browser tools to inspect it before answering. You can request screenshots,
DOM, accessibility information, console logs, or execute page JavaScript, and
interact with the page. Choose whichever observations help; no observation is
provided until you request it. Screenshots are images in tool results.
Coordinates are CSS pixels relative to the current viewport. Use a CSS selector
or both x and y for click/hover. When finished, respond with only the final
answer (a short value, name, or choice letter). Do not include an explanation.

documents.title: Total CO2 Emissions by Country (2022): data source
documents.text: The Total CO2 Emissions by Country (2022) chart on the climate dashboard is drawn from climate.csv. The chart is regenerated from that file whenever it changes.

documents.title: Total CO2 Emissions by Country (2022): axes and units
documents.text: In the Total CO2 Emissions by Country (2022) chart on the climate dashboard, the x axis shows Country and the y axis shows CO2 (million tonnes).

documents.title: Total CO2 Emissions by Country (2022): dashboard layout
documents.text: The climate dashboard shows the Total CO2 Emissions by Country (2022) chart in a single card; its legend, when present, lists the series in drawing order.
